recipe.visualDefinition: A high-grain, black-and-white portrait of a man in a dark shirt positioned on the right third of the frame, set against a vast, desolate, and bright landscape. The composition is bisected by a horizontal horizon line, with typography spanning across the subject and the negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right vertical third while looking down and left.
High-contrast dark clothing against a light, textured background.
Typography bridges the gap between the empty landscape and the human figure.
Heavy film grain creates a tactile, gritty surface across the entire image.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic grayscale palette for the image.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-close-up portrait positioned on the right, scaled to occupy roughly 40% of the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the subject's clothing acts as the primary anchor against the light background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows his downward gaze to the left, and lands on the primary display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space on the left side, characterized by a textured, bright landscape.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between subject and background; low saturation overall with a single desaturated color accent.
paletteRestrictions: Single muted purple or blue accent

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the negative space of the landscape
placed directly over the subject's chest

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between large, condensed, colored uppercase and small, wide-tracked, white lowercase.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the center axis

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, vertical nature of the display text.
Provides the humanist, bold lowercase feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-grain, black and white photograph of a man in a black button-down shirt standing in a vast, bright salt flat landscape. The man is on the right side of the frame, looking down and to the left. The horizon line is low. The image should have a gritty, film-like texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase condensed sans-serif text in muted purple on the left side. Add lowercase bold sans-serif text in white with very wide tracking on the right side, overlapping the subject's chest.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible and consistent?
Is the subject positioned off-center to the right?
Does the purple text have wide tracking?
Is the white text lowercase and placed over the subject?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the purple accent
Horizontal position of the horizon line
Width of the tracking on the subtitle
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between subject and background.
Ensure the grain does not obscure the legibility of the text.
Verify the horizontal alignment of the two text blocks.
Confirm the color of the display text is a desaturated purple.
recipe.reuseFormula: Grainy B&W Portrait + Off-center Composition + Wide-tracked Sans-serif Overlay
